title: CSV Import/Export
summary: toCsv/escapeCsvCell export helpers plus a generic CSV import parser (upsert-by-key friendly, per-row errors, row cap) and a reference bulk-import dialog. Generalized to any keyed record shape — not tied to a specific table.

postInstall.description: For export: call toCsv(header, rows) from lib/csv-io/csv.ts wherever you build a CSV download response (e.g. a route handler returning Content-Type: text/csv).

For import: call parseCsv(text, { headerKey, requiredKeys, parseRow }) from lib/csv-io/import.ts inside a Server Action. Supply headerKey to map your CSV's column names to field keys, and parseRow to validate/coerce each row (e.g. wrap a Zod schema's safeParse). The action then does the upsert-by-key against your table — this module does not touch the database.

Wire components/csv-import-dialog.tsx's onImport prop to your Server Action; it returns { imported, errors } which the dialog renders as a per-row error list. Adapt or replace the component per your domain — it is a reference starting point, not a drop-in for every table.
Run the module's unit tests plus a full verify.
postInstall.command: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
